input: queries and words contain nonempty ASCII lowercase strings; either outer list may be empty. Let Q/W be their lengths and T the total characters. Collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse/accessor-backed collections. Strings are ordinary/primitive strings. Every collection length and computed allocation size fits [0,4294967295], with padded sizes explicitly included. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is allowed. Preconditions are not runtime-checked, and allocation/resource capacity or completion is not guaranteed by declared bounds. Python integer inputs are plain int, excluding bool.
return: Fresh length-Q array counting for each query how many words have a strictly larger frequency of their own lexicographically smallest character.
mutation_aliasing: Inputs and caller-held aliases remain unchanged; only private working state is used. The Solution instance retains no state. Returned array is fresh; sorting applies only to private scalar frequencies.
numeric: Smallest-character frequency lies between1 and string length. Comparator differences and upper-bound arithmetic are exact. Strictly larger is implemented by the first sorted frequency greater than the query frequency. All integer inputs/intermediates remain within [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: O(T+26*(Q+W)+W*log(W+1)+Q*log(W+1)+1) time under comparison sort and O(W+Q+26) auxiliary/output space. Each histogram and first-positive scan is fully counted. Bounds include ordinary built-in operations/allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop and any explicitly stated hash/sort behavior.

helpers.name: letter_counts
helpers.contract: Returns a fresh26-entry histogram for an ASCII lowercase string, with index0 for a through25 for z.
helpers.cost: O(L+26) time/O(26) space for length L; full helper is separately charged in each client. Its complete definition is 157 UTF-8 bytes; separator newlines count toward total source bytes.

helpers.name: upper_bound
helpers.contract: Returns first frequency strictly greater than target in a sorted array, or its length.
helpers.cost: O(log(W+1)) time/O(1) space per query; byte-identical to the charged helper in0034/1150. Its complete definition is 285 UTF-8 bytes; separator newlines count toward total source bytes.
